decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed extension 
shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the _north and south flank walsl of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of existing single storey rear extension and the erection of a single storey rear conservatory to existing dwellinghouse.
